hook: 日 is the sun: from one sunrise to the next is one day, like 毎日 (every day).
Sun (日) + origin (本): land where the sun rises; にっぽん is the strong, sporty way to say it.
Sun (日) + origin (本): the land of the rising sun, Japan.
大 looks like a person with arms stretched wide: big! As in 大学 (big school, university).
From 行く (to go): 行き is the going, like 東京行き (bound for Tokyo).
From 行く (to go), older reading ゆく: 東京行き on train signs means bound for Tokyo.
Shining star (曜) + day (日): weekdays are named after sky bodies, like 月曜日 (moon day).
A line through the middle of a box: inside, middle, like 中国 (middle country, China).
来 means come: 来週 is the week that is coming, next week.
生 is a plant sprouting from the ground: life, birth, as in 先生 and 学生.
生 means life: food still "alive", not cooked, is raw, like 生ビール (draft beer).
From 出る (to go out): 出口 is the way out.
Sun (日) shining through a gap in a gate (門): a space or pause between things.
Now (今) + day (日): this day; こんにち is the formal reading, heard in こんにちは.
A knife (刀) cutting something apart: a part; 五分五分 means fifty-fifty.
A knife (刀) splitting (八) something: a part or share, as in 自分 (oneself).
上 means up or above: じょう is the higher, better one, like 上級 (advanced level).
上 means up or above: うわ is the outer, top layer, like 上着 (jacket over clothes).
上 means up: かみ is the upper end, like 川上 (upstream).
A child (子) under a roof, learning: 学 is study, as in 大学 and 学生.
後 means after or behind: 午後 is after noon, the afternoon.
後 means after: のち is a formal "later", as in weather news 晴れ後雨 (sunny, later rain).
From 考える (to think): 考え is a thought or idea in your head.
小 shows something split into tiny bits: small, as in 小学校 (elementary school).
夜 is night: よ appears in 夜中 (middle of the night) and 夜明け (dawn).
田 looks like a rice field seen from above, cut into four plots.
From 作る (to make): 作 is a thing made, a work or harvest, as in 作品 (artwork).
What (何) + で (by): "by what reason?", so: why?
金 is gold or metal: お金 is money, the metal coins in your pocket.
金 is gold: 金メダル is a gold medal, and 金曜日 is Friday (metal day).
From 教える (to teach): 教え is what is taught, a teaching.
週 means week; sound hook: a shoe (しゅう) walking through the week, 今週 (this week).
者 means person: もの here is "someone", as in 若者 (young person).
Rice field (田) + power (力) = man (男): the strong person working the field.
From 読む (to read): 読み is a reading, like a kanji's reading.
度 means times: たび is each time, as in この度 (this time).
True (本) + hit (当): it hits the truth; ほんと is the casual short form of ほんとう.
方 means direction or side: こっちの方 is this side, this way.
From 笑う (to laugh): 笑 has bamboo (竹) on top, like eyes crinkled up laughing.
友 is two hands together: a friend, as in 友だち.
What (何) + か (question marker): "some what", something.
From 遅れる (to be late): 遅れ is a delay; 遅 has the road radical (⻌), slow on the road.
下 means below: しも is the lower end, like 川下 (downstream).
下 means down: げ is in 下車 (getting off a train) and 下水 (sewage).
Evening (夕) + mouth (口): in the dark you call out your name, as in 名前.
場 has earth (土) on the left: a piece of ground, a place, like 場所.
全 means all: 全部 is all the parts, everything.
Sound (音) over heart (心): the voice of your heart, your will or meaning, as in 意味.
From 疲れる (to get tired): 疲 has the sickness radical (疒), tired like being ill.
野 means field: 野原 (のはら) is an open grassy field.
文 means writing: 文 is a sentence, and 作文 is writing an essay.
Person (亻) + master (主): where a person is master, their home; 住所 is your address.
Think (思い) + come out (出): thoughts that come out from the past, memories.
Drawing (図) + writing (書): books; 図書館 is the library.
対 means opposite or versus: 日本対ブラジル is Japan versus Brazil.
対 means facing each other: つい is a matching pair, like two cups made as a set.
題 means title or topic: 問題 is a question, 宿題 is homework.
Grass (艹) on top, a person and tree under: leaves from a plant, tea.
From 願う (to wish): 願い is a wish; お願いします means please.
空 means sky or empty: an empty box is like empty sky, nothing inside.
Words (言) + ten (十): counting by tens, a total; 時計 counts time, a clock.
楽 means fun and ease: らく is comfort, an easy relaxed feeling.
From 違う (to differ): 違い is a difference.
音 means sound: 音楽 (sound + fun) is music.
Fit (合) the standard (格): you meet the level, so you pass the exam.
Person (亻) + move (動): a person moving to work; from 働く (to work).
音 means sound: ね is a soft, nice sound, like a bell's tone or 虫の音 (insect song).
One (一) + time (時): for one time period, temporarily; also one o'clock.
From 切る (to cut): 切り is the cut, the place where you stop.
旅 means journey: 旅に出る is to set out on a trip; 旅行 is travel.
A tree (木) with a long top line: the tip of the branch, the end.
A tree (木) with the top line longest: the very tip, the end, like 週末 (weekend).
From 借りる (to borrow): 借り is something borrowed, a debt.
円 means circle: Japan's money, the yen, is named after round coins.
円 means circle: まる is a round shape, a circle drawn on paper.
Earth (土) on the left: 地 is ground or land, as in 地図 (land drawing, map).
不 means not: 不便 is not convenient, inconvenient.
不 means not: read ぶ in a few words like 不用心 (not careful).
From 連れる (to take along): 連れ is the person you take with you, your companion.
正 means correct: せい is what is right and regular, as in 正解 (correct answer).
Sound hook: you bend (べん) over your tote (とう) bag to grab your box lunch.
Words (言) on the left: 説 is explaining with words, a theory; 小説 is a novel.
Sun (日) on the left: 昨 is time that has passed, as in 昨年 (last year).
四 is four, a box with four sides; say よん, since し sounds like death (死).
Tie up (結) + fruit (果): the fruit that grows at the end, the result.
約 means promise or about: 約十分 is about ten minutes.
図 means drawing: 地図 is a land drawing, a map.
元 means origin: もと is where something started, the original or former state.
実 means fruit or truth: み is the fruit a tree gives, its good result.
面 means face or surface: お面 is a mask you wear on your face.
Carry (運) + turn (転): moving and turning a car, driving.
From 感じる (to feel): 感 has heart (心) at the bottom, a feeling.
悪 has heart (心) at the bottom: a bad heart, evil.
Birth (誕) + life (生): coming to life; 誕生日 is your birthday.
Next (次) + order (第): things come in order, each depending on the one before.
Write down (記) + thing (事): things written down, a news article.
直 means straight, direct: with no detour, it comes soon, right away.
数 means number: 数学 (number study) is mathematics.
Each other (相) + hand (手): the hand facing yours, your partner or opponent.
数 means number: かず is how many, like counting things on your fingers.
急 means hurry: 急に is suddenly, as if in a rush.
土 looks like a plant sprouting from the ground: soil, earth.
運 means carry: luck is what life carries to you.
都 means capital: みやこ is the old capital city, like Kyoto.
From 生まれる (to be born): 生 means life, so 生まれ is your birth or birthplace.
Words (言) on the left: 訳 is turning words into another language, translation.
布 has cloth (巾) at the bottom: a piece of cloth.
難 means difficult: なん is a hardship, as in 困難 (difficulty).
Real (本) + person (人): the real person himself, not someone else.
Heart (忄) + birth (生): what you are born with, your nature or gender.
From 貸す (to lend): 貸 has money (貝, shell) at the bottom, money lent out.
無 means nothing: む is zero, as in 無理 (no reason, impossible).
無 means without: ぶ is in 無事 (without incident, safe).
Not (不) + think (思) + discuss (議): beyond thinking and talking about, a mystery.
Eat (食) on the left: 飯 is cooked rice, a meal; ご飯 is the polite word.
Water (氵) on the left: 温 is warm, like warm water or a warm meal.
Sure (確) + accept (認): make sure and accept it, confirm.
From 負ける (to lose): 負け is a defeat.
Thing (事) + matter (件): something that happened, an incident, like a crime.
Truth (実) + は: "as for the truth...", actually.
Give (給) + fee (料): the money given to you, your salary.
Stay (留) + study (学): staying in another country to study.
便 means convenience or mail: びん is a flight or delivery, like 航空便 (airmail).
魚 is a picture of a fish with tail fins (灬); うお is old, as in 魚市場 (fish market).
Fruit (菓) + small thing (子): small sweet things; お菓子 is sweets.
Write down (記) + record (録): writing things down to keep, a record.
Three boxes (口) stacked up: lots of goods, things for sale.
品 is goods: ひん is also quality or class, as in 上品 (classy, elegant).
Tree (木) + eye (目): looking closely at something, its appearance or aspect.
Look at (観) + light (光): go look at the shining sights, sightseeing.
Roof (宀) + person (亻) + hundred (百): a roof where many people stay, an inn.
格 means status or level: 合格 is reaching the level, passing.
From 知らせる (to let know): 知 means know, so 知らせ is news, a notice.
From (以) + come (来): from that point coming up to now, since.
From 暮らす (to live): 暮 has sun (日) at the bottom, day after day of living.
Writing (書) + kind (類): all kinds of written papers, documents.
Healthy (健) + peaceful (康): a strong, calm body, good health.
Most (最) + middle (中): right in the middle of doing something.
Middle (中) + stop (止): stop in the middle, call it off.
Both kanji have tree (木) on the left: early machines were made of wood.
House (家) + fee (賃): the money you pay for a house, rent.
Father (父) + parent (親): the father parent.
Above (上) + in charge (司): the person above you at work, your boss.
世 means world or generation: よ is the world we live in, as in この世 (this world).
段 means step: 階段 is stairs, step after step.
Person (亻) + worry (憂): a caring person is kind and excellent; 優 is the top grade.
Feeling (気) + taste (味): a slight touch of something, like 風邪気味 (a bit of a cold).
Tight (緊) + stretch (張): stretched tight, nervous and tense.
Tie up (結) + game (局): when the game is tied up at the end, after all.
Post (郵) + delivery (便): the postal service; 郵便局 is the post office.
Big (大) + meeting (会): a big meeting, a tournament.
Fly (飛) + go (行): going by flying; 飛行機 is a flying machine, a plane.
Bamboo (竹) on top of a hand holding a brush (聿): a bamboo writing brush.
Altar (礻) on the left: showing respect, a bow or thanks; 失礼 is losing manners.
Person (亻) + together (共): a person who goes along with you, a companion.
Join (参) + add (加): add yourself to the group, take part.
Laugh (笑) + face (顔): a laughing face, a smile.
One side (片) + attach (付): put each thing back in its place, tidying up.
Water (氵) on the left: 注 is to pour; a note pours extra meaning into a text.
People (人) + spirit (気): the good feeling people have for something, popularity.
Person (人) + between (間): people living among each other, human beings.
Person (亻) + straight (直): a fair, straight price; 値段 is price.
Year (年) + span (間): over the span of a year, yearly.
Judge (判) + cut off (断): judge and cut off the other choices, a decision.
Crime (犯) + person (人): the person who did the crime.
Sell (販) + sell (売): selling; 自動販売機 is a vending machine.
From 振る (to swing, wave): 振り is your way of moving, your style or manner.
表 means surface or show: ひょう is a chart that shows data at a glance.
奥 means the deep inside: the back room, far from the door.
Self (自) + move (動): moves by itself, automatic.
Trade (商) + goods (品): goods for trade, merchandise.
One (一) + life (生): one whole life, all your life.
Make (作) + expert (家): an expert who makes stories, a writer.
Night (夜) + middle (中): the middle of the night.
Pour (注) + writing (文): pour your wishes into words, an order.
From 始まる (to begin): 始まり is the beginning.
Tree (木) on the left: 桜 is the cherry tree, Japan's spring flower.
A tree (木) with a band (口) tied around it: a bundle tied together.
局 means office or bureau: 郵便局 is the post office.
Person (亻) + cow (牛): a matter or case to deal with; 事件 is an incident.
Control (管) + order (理): keeping things in order, management.
Before (予) + report (報): a report before it happens, a forecast.
Difference (違い) + none (ない): no chance it is different, so it must be true.
Late (遅) + moment (刻): late for the set time.
Bitter (苦) + hand (手): something bitter in your hands, so you are weak at it.
Sun (日) + middle (中): while the sun is up, in the daytime.
Altar (示) at the bottom: a hand offering meat to the gods, a festival.
Money (貝, shell) at the bottom: 質 is what something is worth, its quality.
Self (自, a nose) over heart (心): air through your nose to the heart, breath.
One (一) + side (方): on one side... and on the other hand.
No (無) + poor horse (駄): a useless horse, a waste.
Say (申し) + reason (訳): saying your reasons, an excuse; 申し訳ない means I am sorry.
Fee (料) + money (金): money you pay, a charge.
Next (次) + repeat mark (々): next, next, one after another.
Years (年) + come close (寄): someone the years have come to, an old person.
Grass (艹) + old (古): old bitter herbs; 苦 is bitterness, suffering.
至 shows an arrow hitting the ground: to arrive, to reach.
Sea (海) + outside (外): beyond the sea, overseas.
Make (作) + job (業): making things as a job, work or an operation.
Friend (友) + person (人): a friend; the formal word for 友だち.
